typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		CM_ID as double,
		Program_Text as string,
		CaseType_Text as string,
		CM_Text as string,
		CM_Yes as string,
		Member_ as integer,
		L_Name as string,
		CaseType_ID as string,
		Reason_Text as string,
		Program_id as string,
		Open_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		F_Name as string,
		Sort as string,
		InsertTimeStamp as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Close_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Last_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Reason_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CM_ID,
		Program_Text,
		CaseType_Text,
		CM_Text,
		CM_Yes,
		Member_ = {Member#},
		L_Name,
		CaseType_ID,
		Reason_Text,
		Program_id,
		Open_date,
		F_Name,
		Sort,
		InsertTimeStamp,
		Close_date,
		Last_date,
		Reason_ID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
